summary.text: Sara Agerton is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A healthcare professional and former Mechanicsburg Borough Council member, she describes a twenty-year career in social work.

paragraphs.text: Sara Agerton's Ballotpedia survey response says she grew up in a small town in Pennsylvania, where her father was a welder and her mother stayed home.
It says she had a twenty-year career in social work, from helping children in foster care to end-of-life hospice care.
The response says Agerton won a seat on Mechanicsburg Borough Council as its only Democrat and served four years.
It lists lowering costs, and expanding access to housing, healthcare and childcare, among her priorities.
